behavior: Four labels per valid clock are accumulated into cropped 4x4 ROI cells. Retain the winning color only with >=4 pixels and >=75% of colored support. Store 2-bit color plus 5-bit winning count.
Synchronous row histogram RAM and two frame RAMs have no array reset. Each full capture overwrites every ROI cell; coordinates advance only with input valid.
Begin analysis after the last ROI cell write, not necessarily global EOF. Four-neighbor BFS clears each cell when queued, processes each retained cell once, and scans seeds in row-major order.

The 4096-entry queue is finite; queue overflow or >8 accepted regions sets frame overflow. All partial candidates become invalid at frame_done. Busy bank/request collision emits fault and sticky error.
Bounds cover occupied cells and clamp to ROI. Area sums winning-color pixels. Keep existing minimum area, size, 2:1 aspect and >=25% fill filters. Same-color touching objects remain merged.
All region statistics and largest-region diagnostics belong to one captured epoch. Fill is integer percentage from bounded repeated subtraction at the end of analysis.
constraints: Anlogic PH1P35MDG324/-3, synthesizable Verilog-2001; no video backpressure or pixel-path latency change.
W>=16 and divisible by16; valid ROI within 12-bit image bounds. ROI cell count <=65536 and ROI pixel area <2^20. Default ROI64,160..1216,640 has34560 cells.
C_QUEUE_BITS>=1, default12; C_MAX_CANDIDATES in1..8. Four-connected cells quantize occupied-cell edges by up to3 pixels; support filtering may remove small tips.

Worst-case processing bound <=40*ROI_cells+128 clocks. At103.520MHz and720P60, default budget is1725333 clocks; measured stress traces are separate evidence. Dense frames may miss the immediately following display boundary.
corner_cases: Partial first/last ROI cells and final incomplete image row must be written once.
Invalid bubbles do not duplicate gate counts or cell input. Raw gate occupancy remains unchanged.
A bad/overflow frame cannot provide new counting events or empty-gate evidence.
A cleared processing bank may only be reused after its job ends; dropped capture frames cannot overwrite it.
verification_cases: Independent Python/OpenCV and16 RTL scenes including same-X disconnected regions, holes and9 candidates.
Partial ROI and2-entry queue limit, support3/4 boundary, recovery and intentionally excessive input frame rate.
Actual720P60 solid/checker/empty processing budgets with alternating capture banks.
Actual RGB frontend -> detector -> tracker noise regression; runtime28frames and4full720P DDR frames.

behavior: Consume the gamma-corrected four-pixel RGB96 stream from isp_top; connect color front, bounded2Dcomponents, track/count, graphics, BCD, OSD and the unchanged RGB128 packer.

Forward early by one clock independently of pixel SOF. The runtime pixel path remains seven registered cycles: two front, two overlay, two OSD and one packer. The upstream gamma adds one cycle outside this module.
Reject old-epoch results. Tag decimal work by both epoch and job sequence; only a fully formatted snapshot can commit at a later early boundary.
Camera status is coherent across domains; runtime freezes it at advance frame boundary before OSD. A fourth text row shows FPS/EXP/G/RB/WB/CAL without any extra video register stage.
Expose board-key long-press toggles without adding any video/early register stage. D5/A9 short requests commit on early after debounced release.
Color-support repair adds1pixel register in front only; runtime now7pixel stages and1independent advance-early stage.

Replace the retired column detector with ball_components; tracker/counter implementations and raw gate semantics unchanged. At done, capture diagnostics before decimal conversion; commit all diagnostic BCD and N/R atomically with existing epoch/job snapshot.
constraints: W is a multiple of16, coordinates are12bit; configured ROI cell count<=65536 and pixel area<2^20. Default1280x720.
No video ready/backpressure or frame-dropping substitution; detector faults do not alter video byte count.
Default candidate width and height limits are inclusive12..384 pixels, minimum classified area128. Normal classification operates on gamma-corrected RGB; strict thresholds remain150/50.
corner_cases: Reset or configuration change has priority over old results.
Video invalid cycles must not advance pixel coordinates or packer phase.
Disconnected same-X regions can be extracted; count mode still requires at most one ball per gate and three clear raw-gate frames.
verification_cases: sim/tb_ball_runtime.v:28frames, diagnostic N1 W0016 H0020 A0000272 F085 R0, immutable diagnostic snapshot, key commits, stale epoch/job rejection and count clear.
sim/tb_ball_hdmi_lowlight.v:4full720P frames and691200DDR words, actual third-frame capture and independent model/glyph probes.
sim/tb_ball_components_count_fault.v verifies that an overflowing frame cannot increment an armed counter.

behavior: One character/glyph lookup is shared by four aligned pixels; lookup and composition take two registered cycles.
Use complete BCD snapshots for coordinates and counts. Five-by-seven glyphs are doubled; a dark panel occupies y<144 without changing stream length.

The first title row includes the GAMMA marker in character columns24..28 retained from prior low-light builds; the fifth-row CCL4 marker identifies this milestone; marker text does not alter pixel/line/frame length.
Camera status is coherent across domains; runtime freezes it at advance frame boundary before OSD. A fourth text row shows FPS/EXP/G/RB/WB/CAL without any extra video register stage.
Add row128..141 with CCL4 N/W/H/A/F/R; panel extends to y143. Original lookup/composition remains two registered clocks. Rejection is hexadecimal bitmask; ERR meanings remain unchanged.
constraints: W is a multiple of16, coordinates are12bit; configured ROI cell count<=65536 and pixel area<2^20. Default1280x720.
No video ready/backpressure or frame-dropping substitution; detector faults do not alter video byte count.
corner_cases: Reset or configuration change has priority over old results.
Video invalid cycles must not advance pixel coordinates or packer phase.
Disconnected same-X regions can be extracted; count mode still requires at most one ball per gate and three clear raw-gate frames.
